step1.eyebrow: Show the world what you have. And what you are looking for.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.subtitle: The answers to the most common questions. And if yours isn't here, ask the AI just below.

i1.q: What are the platform's membership levels?
i1.a: There are three: Bronze, Silver and Gold. Bronze and Silver are not subscription plans: they reflect how qualified the information in your profile is under Who I Am, What I Have and What I Need. Every account starts at Bronze, and Silver comes when that information meets the platform's completeness and quality criteria. Neither of them has a monthly fee. Gold is a premium category, with a monthly fee and exclusive benefits.

i2.q: How does the non-disclosure agreement (NDA) work in the Deal Room?
i2.a: The Deal Room is the private room where the two of you negotiate inside the platform. Before any conversation there, both parties sign a non-disclosure agreement. The room is only released after both signatures, and everything exchanged there is protected by the agreement.

i3.q: How does the Deal Room, the private negotiation room, work?
i3.a: You show interest in an opportunity and, when the other party accepts, the platform creates a private room for the two of you. Inside it are the chat and the documents for the deal, all conditional on the signed NDA. The idea is to leave the loose conversation behind and move into a space with clear rules.

i4.q: What is the Gold level and how do I get it?
i4.a: Gold Status is the network's premium category, with a monthly fee: first-hand access to selected national and international business opportunities, invitations to strategic gatherings and priority in the communication of opportunities exclusive to the category. It is not an automatic step up from Silver: it depends on joining the premium category and on the platform's specific rules.

i5.q: What kinds of opportunities can I find on the platform?
i5.a: Many kinds: offers of products and services, requests from those looking for a supplier, searches for investment, commercial partnerships and distribution channels. Before appearing to other members, every opportunity goes through an automatic check against the platform's rules and through approval by our team.

i6.q: How does the AI find the pairings between profiles and opportunities?
i6.a: The system compares profiles across dimensions such as specialty, sector, goals, location, values and investment capacity, and calculates a compatibility score. For the strongest connections, the AI writes an explanation of why that partnership makes sense, so you can decide with context.
